The oven is fixed

The element went in this morning and the first loaf since March came out of it an hour ago. It is not a good loaf. The thermostat reads twenty degrees low and I have not compensated for it yet, so the crust is pale and the crumb is tighter than it should be. The oven works, though, and everything that has been on hold for two months is no longer on hold. There is a list on the door of things to bake first, written in March and not looked at since, and most of it still sounds right.
